extraits.texte: Giving 3 stars because idk why I thought it would be bigger, I bought the coffee scrub too and it’s in a way bigger packaging but any I’ve been a long time user of St.Ives but most times I get it at the super market so first time ordering and I wished it was the usual size, this is kind of a travel size-ish 🫤🫤

extraits.titre: Gentle exfoliation for face and body.
extraits.texte: I wouldn’t use anything else but St. Ives for my face. I use a few times a week to exfoliate. Nice scent and gentle on my sensitive skin. Convenient packaging for the shower. Nice scent with no chemicals smell.
Always will have this available. It is still the only product that helps control oil.

extraits.titre: Great cleanser at a great price
extraits.texte: My skin is noticeably smoother and brighter after using this product for just under two weeks. The exfoliation is gentle and the scent is so refreshing - highly recommended.

Much lighter and softer grit than original. Doesn’t feel like ‘it’s scrubbing’ like original does but skin actually looks exfoliated afterwards. Consistency it’s wetter and looser . See pic. Smell a little perfumey…not crazy about it. Not terrible tho. May go back to original formula.

reserve: Skin-type and concern detail is limited in the reviews supplied, which focus mostly on scent, texture, and value rather than specific skin outcomes.
